title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - DayProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/DayProfile. [COSEM] This class represents a list of scheduled actions which are defined by a script to be executed and the corresponding activation time.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DayProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasDaySchedule.description: Relationship. The day schedule of a day profile.
